answer: Unrepeatable challenge-response attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge whose correct reply depends on a live external state—a specific sonnet's current line count, a river gauge reading, a karst spring's flow value—signed and timestamped. Replays and precomputed answers fail, so every identity pays a real-time query and signature cost per challenge. Attackers must operate distinct live queries and signers per identity, making mass registration cost scale linearly with identity count.
